title: Why a Space-Based Missile Interceptor System Is Not Viable
excerpt: Despite decades of support, the resources required to deploy space-based interceptors would be better spent on other layers of US missile defense.
body_paragraphs: To learn more about what a constellation of space-based missile defense layer might look like, explore the CSIS Aerospace Security Data Repository below, or click here.
For best experience, please view on a desktop computer.
